summary.intent: Run the GSD secure-phase workflow for Phase 69 (FUSE/WinFSP Rust integration and grant root awareness) to verify threat mitigations from the 25 PLAN files' threat models and produce an updated SECURITY.md.
summary.outcome: Manually assembled and committed 69-SECURITY.md with threats_open: 0 (109 threats: 105 mitigated/closed, 4 accepted below the 'high' block threshold) after the spawned gsd-security-auditor agent stalled mid-stream without writing any output; also determined the TS sdk-e2e gate was N/A for this Rust-only phase.

repo: Phase 69's 25 PLAN.md files all carry parseable <threat_model> blocks (register_authored_at_plan_time: true), ASVS L1, block_on: high.

The TS sdk-e2e suite only exercises the TypeScript client→API IPNS round-trip; it is not implicated when a phase only touches Rust crates (packages/sdk/src, sdk-core/src, apps/api/src, api-client/src untouched).
Typechecking changed .mts helper scripts requires pnpm install then pnpm exec, per the known @types/node local-flake trap.
Bulk of this phase's threat register (25 of 109 threats, tagged '-SC') are supply-chain 'cargo installs → zero new crates' items that close in one shot via an empty dependency diff.
workflow: The gsd-security-auditor subagent can stall mid-stream (API Error: Response stalled) on large threat registers (109 threats, ~7.6 min, 17 tool uses) and die without writing any output — check working tree state before assuming failure, then consider manually assembling the report from already-gathered data (threat register, VERIFICATION.md SC evidence, dependency diff) rather than re-spawning a stall-prone agent.

Counting threat dispositions via grep over prose text is unreliable — counting occurrences of the word 'accept' in surrounding text gave 6, but the authoritative count from the actual disposition column was 4; always parse the structured column, not free text.

friction: gsd-security-auditor agent stalled mid-stream after ~7.6 minutes and 17 tool calls, returning only 'API Error: Response stalled mid-stream' with no SECURITY.md written, forcing manual recovery.
Initial disposition count (accept rows) was wrong (6 vs actual 4) due to counting a word in prose instead of the parsed disposition column.
open_items: Consider reporting/investigating why gsd-security-auditor stalls on large (100+) threat registers, since re-spawning was judged not worth the risk this time.
4 accepted-risk threats (low/medium severity) are documented in 69-SECURITY.md as accepted rather than mitigated — worth revisiting if ASVS level is raised above L1 for this phase.
